fusions.name: Cold Verdict
fusions.desc: Fires an iron bolt that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its armour and leaving it [Sundered] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Weight
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 20 damage to a target at or below 30% health and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Regard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 26 damage for 10 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Hard Read
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
